title: FRED Dollar Index Regime Tracker
description: US Dollar trade-weighted index regime tracker for the FX & Rate-Differential Brief. Pulls three FRED dollar indices: DTWEXBGS (Broad Dollar - all USD trade partners), DTWEXAFEGS (Advanced Foreign Economies - DXY-equivalent for major currencies), and DTWEXEMEGS (Emerging Market Economies - EM stress proxy). Each row reports latest value, 30-day change %, 90-day change %, percentile rank vs trailing 1-year window, and a regime flag (BREAKING_OUT / STRONG / NEUTRAL / SOFT / BREAKING_DOWN). Investment thesis maps to UUP (long broad-dollar), UDN (short broad-dollar), and EM-FX hedge ETFs. Uses existing FRED_API_KEY.
